headline: Father claims Tahsif Souri's death was not suicide
summary: The father of former Air Force officer Tahsif Souri, whose body was found in the Turag river, rejects suicide claims and demands a full investigation.
details: The body of Tahsif Souri, a former officer of the Bangladesh Air Force, was found in the Turag river.
His father has publicly rejected the possibility of suicide, stating that a thorough investigation will reveal the culprits behind his death.
The case has drawn significant attention due to Tahsif's reported comments regarding a video of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's helicopter departure on August 5.
A friend of the deceased, identified as Deep, was the last person to meet Tahsif before his death, leading to further scrutiny of the circumstances surrounding the event.
The Home Minister has stated that there will be no further comments on the case until the official probe concludes.
The family's demand for justice continues as the authorities investigate the midnight parting and the final moments of the officer.
caption:
A former Air Force officer's body was found in the Turag river, but his father insists it was not suicide.

The body of Tahsif Souri, a former officer of the Bangladesh Air Force, was found in the Turag river.

His father has publicly rejected the possibility of suicide, stating that a thorough investigation will reveal the culprits behind his death.

The case has drawn significant attention due to Tahsif's reported comments regarding a video of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's helicopter departure on August 5.

A friend of the deceased, identified as Deep, was the last person to meet Tahsif before his death, leading to further scrutiny of the circumstances surrounding the event.

The Home Minister has stated that there will be no further comments on the case until the official probe concludes.

The family's demand for justice continues as the authorities investigate the midnight parting and the final moments of the officer.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com

headline_marked: BNP's Mirza Faisal wins Thakurgaon-1 by-election [[by 131,336 votes]]
headline: BNP's Mirza Faisal wins Thakurgaon-1 by-election by 131,336 votes
summary: Mirza Faisal Amin, brother of BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, secured a landslide victory in the Thakurgaon-1 by-election. He defeated his closest rival by over 130,000 votes.
details: BNP candidate Mirza Faisal Amin has won the Thakurgaon-1 by-election, defeating his closest rival, Jamaat-e-Islami candidate Delawar Hosen, by a significant margin of 131,336 votes.

The Returning Officer and Thakurgaon District Election Officer Kamrul Islam officially declared Faisal the winner around 9:30 PM on Thursday. Faisal is the younger brother of BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.

Faisal garnered 227,789 votes in the election, while his main opponent, Delawar, secured 96,453 votes. Election and administrative officials from various levels of the district were present during the announcement of the results.
caption:
BNP's Mirza Faisal Amin wins Thakurgaon-1 by-election by a margin of 131,336 votes. He secured 227,789 votes against Jamaat-e-Islami's Delawar Hosen.

BNP candidate Mirza Faisal Amin has won the Thakurgaon-1 by-election, defeating his closest rival, Jamaat-e-Islami candidate Delawar Hosen, by a significant margin of 131,336 votes.

The Returning Officer and Thakurgaon District Election Officer Kamrul Islam officially declared Faisal the winner around 9:30 PM on Thursday. Faisal is the younger brother of BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir.

Faisal garnered 227,789 votes in the election, while his main opponent, Delawar, secured 96,453 votes. Election and administrative officials from various levels of the district were present during the announcement of the results.
